meta.description: A review of the KOCH Scan App, a B2B app for a Swiss building supplier that lets tradespeople scan article labels, collect them by commission and order on site, in preparation for taking over its maintenance.

caseStudy.title: KOCH Scan App
caseStudy.lead: A review of the KOCH Scan App, a B2B app for a Swiss building supplier that lets tradespeople scan article labels, collect them by commission and order on site, in preparation for taking over its maintenance.

brief.title: The brief
text: The app had been built by another agency, and we were to take over its maintenance. Before that, the client needed to know what they had: how the app is built, how healthy the code is and what maintaining it would involve.
I reviewed the native iOS app independently and coordinated with the project stakeholders.

contributions.title: What I reviewed
items: The app structure: five tabs for scanning, the article list, ordering, locations and news.
The scanner: auto and tap scan modes, flashlight, detection overlay and manual EAN entry.
The order flow, which runs in a WKWebView with a script message handler.
The SAP Commerce (Hybris) backend with OAuth, and Firebase Crashlytics, Remote Config, Performance and Analytics.
Push notifications with a notification service extension, three Swiss languages, the app version guard and the unit tests.

items.title: A focused scanner
items.text: Auto and tap scanning, a flashlight and manual EAN entry cover real conditions on building sites.

items.title: Unit tests and a version guard
items.text: A base to change the app safely, and a way to retire old versions.

items.title: Ordering in a WebView
items.text: Checkout depends on the web shop and a JavaScript bridge, so both sides have to change together.

items.title: Mixed UI technologies
items.text: UIKit storyboards next to SwiftUI views: workable, but every change needs a clear rule for which to use.

team.title: Team
team.text: An independent assessment, in coordination with the project stakeholders on the client's and the agency's side.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The client got a clear picture of the codebase and of what maintaining it would take. The maintenance engagement itself did not go ahead.
